text: Plastic mulch is laid over the beds after the drip line and base fertilizer are in place, silver side up and black side down, pulled taut but not over-stretched (over-stretching tears it once the plant grows). Planting holes are punched through the mulch in two rows at the pre-marked spacing. Mulch benefits: keeps moisture and heat balanced under the film, reduces weed competition and labor, and keeps fruit clean by keeping it off bare soil.
